search_log: Exelixis releases print only combined 'Net product revenues' (Cabometyx + Cometriq) in tables; the Cabometyx line is printed separately in the Form 10-Q and 10-K revenue tables, so quarters Q1-Q3 are read from 10-Qs and Q4 is derived as fiscal-year (10-K) minus nine months (Q3 10-Q)

fiscal quarters end within a few days of calendar quarter end (52/53-week year ending the Friday closest to 31 December; fiscal 2019 and 2024 had 53 weeks); each is mapped to the calendar quarter it ends in
Q2 2016 release states launch of Cabometyx in late April 2016; Q1 2016 10-Q has no Cabometyx line
